papers.title: CausalMix: Data Mixture as Causal Inference for Language Model Training
papers.what: Casts training-data mixture selection as causal inference: pool statistics are covariates and the mixture is the treatment. A CATE model fit on 512 Qwen2.5-0.5B runs extrapolates the optimal mixture to an 800K pool and a 7B model, beating RegMix across downstream tasks.
papers.builds_on: Causal Inference Intro (Pearl 2010, BB78CC56); DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE)

papers.title: Perceive-to-Reason: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning
papers.what: Splits fine-grained visual reasoning into a Perceiver that localizes evidence and a Reasoner that answers, trained with Perception-Reasoning Alternating GRPO using only final-answer supervision; P2R-4B reaches 93.2% on V-Star and 81.9%/80.5% on HR-Bench-4K/8K.
papers.builds_on: Latent-GRPO (Deng 2026, U4ZPM5DN); DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE); Large Multimodal Reasoning Survey (Li 2025, FPEC4PIH)

papers.title: AutoTrainess: Teaching Language Models to Improve Language Models Autonomously
papers.what: An LM agent that exposes the training pipeline (plan, data, train, evaluate, log) as constrained agent-computer interfaces instead of a raw CLI; scores 26.94 vs 23.21 (CLI-only) on PostTrainBench with GPT-5.4 and generalizes across harnesses.

papers.title: AtomiMed: Hierarchical Atomic Fact-Checking for Universal Clinical-Aware Medical Report Evaluation
papers.what: Evaluates generated medical reports by decomposing them into atomic clinical facts and running an agentic cross-verification loop that mimics multi-radiologist review, decoupling detection from description; correlates with radiologist judgment better than n-gram and model-based metrics across X-ray, CT, MRI, and ultrasound.
papers.builds_on: Med-VQA Hallucination (Wu 2024, ATEFZQA4); Verifiable Physio Reasoning (Wang 2026, 2BGP9QJL)
